## About
Conroe Plumbing works on homes and commercial properties in Conroe, The Woodlands, Montgomery, Willis and the communities around Lake Conroe. Plumbing problems don't keep business hours, so our phones are answered around the clock, every day of the week.
We handle water heater changeouts, sewer line video inspection and repair, property inspections and routine maintenance. Our cameras go inside the pipe to find blockages, and line locators help pinpoint underground pipes so there is less guesswork and less digging.
You can reach us by phone, through the request form, or stop by the office on Old Highway 105 in Conroe.

## Services
- Water heater changeouts: Texas water is hard on water heaters, and replacing them is one of the most common calls we get. We change out and upgrade all types.
- Sewer line video inspection and repair: A camera gives a live view of the inside of your sewer line so we can find the exact spot of the damage and repair it with minimal digging.
- Plumbing property inspections: Buying a home or building? We inspect the plumbing so you know what you are getting.
- Preventative maintenance: Routine care for your plumbing system to help keep small problems from turning into big ones.

## FAQ
Q: Can I call outside normal business hours?
A: Yes. We answer 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including weekends and holidays.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Conroe, The Woodlands, Montgomery, Willis and the communities around Lake Conroe.

Q: How can I pay my bill?
A: You can pay online with a credit card or your PayPal account.

- "If I could give 0 stars I would. It started last night when my punch guy/handyman cut a stub out line for my whole house water filtration system. The line was Pex material and he didn't have the proper tools to make the connection.  It's a new construction house so I wasn't concerned that there wasn't water running to the house last night but wanted to line up a plumber for today (I'm the builder). I called Conroe plumbing and described the situation.  The lady on the phone scheduled the appointment,  said it would be $125 trip charge, $85 for each additional hour and $35 more if they brought a "helper"....then said she would get a plumber to call me to make sure they could do the work. 90 minutes later he called. I told him the situation and even texted him a photo of the pipe. He said no worries, they had the tools, and it would take one guy less than an hour. The next morning on time a young man showed up with a "helper". I showed them to the garage and he began looking at the pipe. From the onset I knew I was in trouble. This kid knew nothing and the helper knew even less. They made 3 trips to their truck, then a 25 minute phone call to their office telling someone over the phone all about the job and asking what to do. He walked back into the garage to tell me the repairs would take all day, because he DIDN'T HAVE THE TOOLS so he had to go back for the right tools and parts, and because it was so complicated he would be charging me $700. Please see pictures below. I told him "no thanks and have a blessed day". $125+ tax = wasted. I then called Moore plumbing supply and talked to them. I drove over purchased 2 shark bite connectors and a section of CPVC (I paid for 10 feet but only needed about 2 feet). Total cost $58 and time taken in the garage to bring water back on by myself = 15 minutes. I'm sure they have helped a lot of people in the community but I shudder to think of the lies and the costs.

Update: Today the owner contacted me and apologized for the experience.  He stated that there was miscommunication between himself and his worker and wanted to make the situation right. He has offered to refund the trip charge and even went so far as to hold a meeting with his staff using this as a "teachable moment" and vowing to offer more value to his customers. Even though my experience wasn't good their response let me know that was an isolated event and they will work to do the right thing." (Allykat500, 4/5)
